svg.aria-label: Renaming a function, one block at a time, in dominator order
svg.title: Renaming a function, one block at a time, in dominator order
svg.desc: The control flow graph of a nine block function, with one block lit at a time in the order an SSA renamer visits them. The walk goes ENTRY, then bb 2, then bb 7, then bb 3, where it fans out across the three blocks in the loop body before coming back for bb 8 and EXIT. That is neither the order the blocks are numbered in nor the order they are printed in the dump. Every block is reached only after the block that all paths to it have to go through, which is what makes it safe to rename in a single walk and is why the phi nodes end up at the top of bb 7.

g.text: The walk starts here, with nothing defined and nothing renamed yet.
<bb 2> hangs off ENTRY, so every name defined up there is still good in here.
<bb 7> hangs off <bb 2>, so every name defined up there is still good in here.
<bb 3> hangs off <bb 7>, so every name defined up there is still good in here.
<bb 4> hangs off <bb 3>, so every name defined up there is still good in here.
<bb 5> hangs off <bb 3>, so every name defined up there is still good in here.
<bb 6> hangs off <bb 3>, so every name defined up there is still good in here.
<bb 8> hangs off <bb 7>, so every name defined up there is still good in here.
EXIT, and there is nothing in it. Everything the function computes has already been renamed by the time the walk arrives here.
